manufacturer_source.name: Apple Support Australia - Identify your iPad model
manufacturer_source.finding: Apple identifies four non-China hardware model numbers for 2026 iPad Air (M4) configurations relevant to Australia: 11-inch Wi-Fi A3459, 11-inch Wi-Fi + Cellular A3460, 13-inch Wi-Fi A3461, and 13-inch Wi-Fi + Cellular A3462. All are available in 128GB, so capacity alone cannot disambiguate the row.

reason: The catalogue row and preserved reseller alias identify only iPad Air M4, 128GB and retail SKU MH5QAX/A. They do not establish 11-inch versus 13-inch or Wi-Fi versus Wi-Fi + Cellular, and no authoritative source located maps MH5QAX/A to one exact Apple hardware model number.
safety_notes: Keep model_number null until the row's exact size and connectivity are independently verified from authoritative Australian evidence.
Do not treat Apple retail/order SKU MH5QAX/A as the canonical hardware model number.
Do not assign one of A3459, A3460, A3461 or A3462 solely from the 128GB capacity because all four relevant variants support 128GB.
The row may ultimately need to be normalized or split by physical size and connectivity before a canonical hardware model number can be assigned.
No production catalogue, pricing, inventory or history record is changed by this evidence package.
Any future production mutation requires a fresh dependency/identity/collision recheck and explicit human authorization.
